cases.element: content.body.ruleUk: "Якщо слово закінчується на приголосну, жіноча форма додає -a"; content.body.scope.noteUk: "слова на -e чи -ista мають одну форму".
cases.defect: These are overgeneralizations. Consonant-final personal nouns can remain unchanged, as in el joven / la joven. Personal nouns in -e can have distinct feminine forms, as in el jefe / la jefa. The listed examples do not establish universal formation rules.
cases.correction: Limit the explanation to the taught patterns: profesor forms profesora by adding -a, while estudiante remains unchanged. Qualify broader statements with 'often' or 'some'.
